title: Instant Mocha Coffee, Pre‑lightened and Pre‑sweetened with Low‑Calorie Sweetener, Reconstituted (5210)

content.title: About
content.content: Instant mocha coffee is a soluble coffee blended with cocoa powder, pre‑lightened and pre‑sweetened with a low‑calorie sweetener. It dissolves quickly in hot water, delivering a fragrant drink with chocolate notes and a gentle sweetness without extra calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Mocha combines coffee and cocoa flavors, making it popular among sweet‑drink lovers.
Pre‑lightening speeds up dissolution and reduces bitterness.
Low‑calorie sweeteners (e.g., stevia) lower the energy value while preserving sweetness.
Soluble coffee retains most of the antioxidants found in freshly brewed coffee.
Portion‑packaged sachets provide convenience and easy portion control.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals and support cellular health.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Caffeine enhances alertness, improves concentration, and can increase metabolic rate.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The use of a low‑calorie sweetener keeps the drink’s calorie count minimal, suitable for weight‑management diets.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: Caffeine and cocoa aroma can improve mood and reduce feelings of fatigue.

items.title: Convenient consumption
items.content: The instant format allows quick preparation anywhere without a coffee machine.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat with excessive caffeine intake.

items.title: Cocoa allergy
items.content: People allergic to cocoa or other ingredients should avoid this product.

items.title: Sweetener tolerance
items.content: Certain low‑calorie sweeteners can cause gastrointestinal discomfort in large amounts.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Caffeine may amplify the effects of some medications, such as central nervous system stimulants.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Pour 200 ml of hot (not boiling) water into a cup, add one sachet (≈2 g) of instant mocha coffee, stir thoroughly until fully dissolved. Optionally add milk or cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep sachets in a dry, cool place, protected from moisture and direct sunlight. After opening, use within 3–6 months.
